f05d1524424f5ec5484b5d0858fee86919307ec0.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes Moonstone Sleet, a threat actor it assesses is North Korean state-aligned and distinct from Diamond Sleet. It uses fake companies and job offers to reach targets, trojanized PuTTY and malicious npm packages to deliver loaders such as SplitLoader and YouieLoad, a malicious tank game called DeTankWar, and FakePenny ransomware first seen in April 2024 with a $6.6M USD BTC demand. Targets include software, education and defense industrial base organizations. The report says the goals appear to be espionage and revenue generation.
